messages:
deploy-bot: publish blocked for repo=redwood/runtime tag=rc-2026-03-03. Cosign verification failed on manifestlist -> attestation annotation KMS arn mismatch. Holding promotion. Error snippet: 'annotation.kmsKeyId expected arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/oldkey but got arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/rotated-key'
Maya Dev: ack. Did we rotate signing keys in the build pipeline overnight? :eyes:
Jason R: we rotated the KMS key for new builds at 02:10 UTC. Staging artifacts from yesterday should still be signed with the old key though. Possible replay/replication pulled a newer attestation to staging mirror?
Liam S: ran `cosign verify --insecure-ignore-tlog repo:rc-2026-03-03` locally — signature OK for linux/amd64 but manifestlist metadata lacks `annotation.kmsKeyId` for linux/arm64 entry. Registry-level attestor rejects missing annotation.
Priya M: if the manifestlist entry is missing the annotation we can either re-sign the manifestlist with the proper KMS arn or pin the previous digest and skip this push. Which do we prefer for minimal blast radius?
Anne Ops: preference = re-sign ephemeral tag, run canary, then promote. Pin old digest for rollback. Keep change window small (30m). :thumbsup:
Jason R: plan I can run now: 1) fetch original digest: `skopeo inspect docker://account.dkr.ecr.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood/runtime:rc-2026-03-03` 2) `skopeo copy docker://account.dkr.ecr...@sha256:<digest> docker://account.dkr.ecr...:rc-kms-rotated` 3) `cosign sign --key kms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/rotated-key account.dkr.ecr...:rc-kms-rotated` 4) push and request deploybot canary. I'll post outputs here.
Maya Dev: also add a short release note: "Artifact re-signed with rotated KMS key to satisfy registry provenance policy; previous digest pinned for rollback." Tag the note with the change window.
Liam S: I'll update deploybot allowlist to accept both KMS arns for 24h: add `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/oldkey` and `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/rotated-key` to `allowed_signers.json` and queue a canary policy push to infra-config.
Priya M: reminder — update observability alert to watch `provenance.verification.failures` and post to #incidents if >3 fails in 10m. Also set a regression eval for sample prompts (sanity check inference output).
OpsBot: deploybot paused promotion to canary due to provenance:annotation-mismatch. Flagged as P0 until manual ack.
deploy-bot: accepted manual override: canary push scheduled (ephemeral tag `rc-kms-rotated`). Full promotion blocked until post-canary sign-off. Monitor logs at https://console.redwood/infrastructure/releases/1709456789 and alert channel #eng-oncall if latency/regression spikes.
Jason R: pushing retag now, will paste `skopeo` + `cosign` output shortly.
Maya Dev: thx. I'll prepare the release note and change window in the release tracker (30m start in ~5m). Everyone watch canary traffic.
deploy-bot: canary started for rc-kms-rotated at 1709456890, will hold full promotion until 1709457405. If canary OK, deploybot will swap tags and update release notes automatically. :white_check_mark:
